label: Technology Across Industries and Culture
blurb: A focused six-fact drill set for Technology Across Industries and Culture.

topics.title: Fintech
topics.hook: Financial technology applies digital tools to payments, lending, insurance, investing, and other financial services.
topics.explainer: Financial technology applies digital tools to payments, lending, insurance, investing, and other financial services. It is a useful TCS Quiz recall point because questions often test the term, person, date, or application together.

connections.fact: Payment gateways, wallets, and fraud checks are fintech services that allow e-commerce purchases to be completed.
Both move an established service online, but fintech handles financial activity while telemedicine handles clinical care.

topics.title: Telemedicine
topics.hook: Telemedicine delivers clinical healthcare remotely through telecommunications technology.
topics.explainer: Telemedicine delivers clinical healthcare remotely through telecommunications technology. It is a useful TCS Quiz recall point because questions often test the term, person, date, or application together.

connections.relationship: Real-time media used for remote care
connections.fact: A telemedicine consultation may use live audio and video streaming, but its purpose is clinical diagnosis or treatment.
Connected urban infrastructure can include remote-health access, while telemedicine itself is specifically a healthcare mode.

topics.title: Precision agriculture
topics.hook: Precision agriculture uses data, sensors, and analysis to manage crops and farm inputs more precisely.
topics.explainer: Precision agriculture uses data, sensors, and analysis to manage crops and farm inputs more precisely. It is a useful TCS Quiz recall point because questions often test the term, person, date, or application together.

connections.fact: Both combine sensors, connectivity, and analytics; one optimises farms and the other urban services.

connections.relationship: Digital services for farm decisions and finance
connections.fact: Farm data can support precision input use and also inform lending or insurance products offered through fintech.

topics.title: Streaming
topics.hook: Streaming delivers audio or video over a network for playback without a complete prior download.
topics.explainer: Streaming delivers audio or video over a network for playback without a complete prior download. It is a useful TCS Quiz recall point because questions often test the term, person, date, or application together.

connections.fact: Live streaming carries the audio and video used in many remote consultations, though it does not itself provide healthcare.
Streaming subscriptions and online shopping are both digital businesses, but one delivers media continuously and the other trades goods or services.

topics.title: E-commerce
topics.hook: Electronic commerce is the buying and selling of goods or services through electronic networks.
topics.explainer: Electronic commerce is the buying and selling of goods or services through electronic networks. It is a useful TCS Quiz recall point because questions often test the term, person, date, or application together.

connections.fact: E-commerce platforms arrange buying and selling; fintech systems process payments, credit, and fraud controls around the transaction.

connections.relationship: Download-free media as a digital product
connections.fact: A streaming subscription may be sold through e-commerce, but streaming describes how the media is delivered.

topics.title: Smart city
topics.hook: A smart city uses digital technology and data to improve urban services and infrastructure.
topics.explainer: A smart city uses digital technology and data to improve urban services and infrastructure. It is a useful TCS Quiz recall point because questions often test the term, person, date, or application together.

connections.relationship: Shared use of sensors and analytics
connections.fact: Smart cities optimise transport or utilities, while precision agriculture applies comparable data tools to fields and farm inputs.
A city digital-services programme may improve access to telemedicine, especially where hospitals connect patients remotely.

questions.q: A mobile app offers instant payments, small loans, and digital insurance. Which sector is it in?
questions.explanation: Fintech applies software and data to financial activities including payments, lending, investing, and insurance.

options: A remote clinical consultation by video
questions.explanation: Telemedicine uses telecommunications to deliver clinical healthcare when patient and clinician are in different locations.

questions.q: Sensors vary fertiliser application across a field according to soil data. What is this?
questions.explanation: Precision agriculture combines measurement, positioning, and analysis to apply farm inputs where and when they are needed.

questions.q: What distinguishes streaming from a conventional complete download?
options: Playback can begin while data continues arriving
The entire file must arrive before playback starts
Streaming never buffers data on the receiving device
Streaming requires permanent offline storage of the complete file
questions.explanation: Streaming delivers successive media data over a network so playback need not wait for the entire file.

questions.q: Which transaction is the clearest example of e-commerce?
options: Ordering a product through an online marketplace
questions.explanation: Electronic commerce covers buying and selling goods or services through online and other electronic networks.

questions.q: Traffic sensors adjust signal timing to reduce congestion. Which concept does this illustrate?
questions.explanation: Smart-city systems use connected devices and data analysis to improve urban infrastructure and public services.

questions.q: How does fintech commonly support e-commerce?
options: By processing payments and detecting transaction fraud
By providing the product-search and catalogue layer
By operating the parcel warehouse and delivery fleet
By manufacturing the goods offered by each seller
questions.explanation: Online trade needs financial rails for authorisation, settlement, credit, and risk management, all common fintech functions.

questions.q: A video platform is used for a remote diagnosis. Which term describes the clinical service, not merely the media transport?
questions.explanation: Streaming carries the call, but the regulated act of delivering healthcare remotely is telemedicine.

questions.q: Which pairing captures a shared technology but different setting?
options: Precision agriculture and smart cities both use sensor data
Streaming and telemedicine always describe the same service
Fintech and e-commerce are identical because both accept payments
Smart-city analytics cannot use techniques also used on farms
questions.explanation: Farms and cities can both optimise resources with sensing and analytics, though their decisions concern crops and urban systems respectively.

questions.q: Which proposal is least consistent with a smart-city project?
options: Removing all measurement from city services
questions.explanation: Smart-city programmes depend on useful measurement and connected management; eliminating data collection removes the defining mechanism.
